title_zh: 了解事物的展开顺序：河马写了一本书
title_en: Understanding the Order of Things: A Book Written by a Hippo
source_file: 了解事物的展开顺序：河马写了一本书（5-8岁）.pptx
full_text_zh:
[P1] 数学来了！
理解事物发展的顺序
了解事物的展开顺序
河马写了一本书
钟林姣 文 李志兴 绘
金盾出版社

[P2] 河马在阅读一本故事书，这本书太吸引人了，河马一口气就读完了。这下没有书看了，他得买一些新的书。
可天气太热了，河马不想去书店。没关系，不去书店也能买书。

河马最喜欢看大熊出版社出版的图书了。前两天，他收到了大熊出版社发来的邮件，里面有新书信息，还有大熊出版社社长写给他的信，上面还配了大熊社长的照片——当然，很多粉丝都会收到。

[P3] 河马打开电脑，找到大熊出版社的售书网站，选购了一些新书，
填好收货地址和姓名，选好付款方式，点击确认订单。
接下来，他只要坐在家里，等快递员把书送过来就好了。

第二天，河马刚吃完早餐，门铃就响了。
叮咚，叮咚——
快递员把书送来了！
河马拆开箱子，检查自己订购的书是否齐全。
没错，是这些书。
河马付了钱，就马上翻看起刚买的书来。

[P4] 没过几天，新买的书又看完了。再看看书架，他再也放不下任何一本书了。
怎么办？没有书看，河马觉得很不自在。睡觉也睡不着！
河马很苦恼，所以给好朋友小老鼠打电话倾诉，小老鼠却说：“你为什么不自己写一本书呢？”
写一本书？
这可真是个好提议，就这么办！
其实河马早就这么想过，他还梦想着自己写的书能在大熊出版社出版呢。只不过，他从没动笔写过。
“快快写，我等着看哦。”

[P5] 有了小老鼠的鼓励，河马立即行动起来。他准备写一本冒险书，书名就叫《河马历险记》。河马先写了一个故事大纲，然后才开始按章节写故事。
故事写得非常顺利，每天晚上睡觉前，河马都会一遍遍阅读自己写的故事。在故事里，河马勇敢无比，他打败了妖怪山的妖怪，帮助精灵王找回了精灵钥匙，还追到了太阳。
写书真是太过瘾了！
书写好了，河马反反复复、仔仔细细地修改了好几遍，就等着投稿了。

[P6] 小老鼠来拜访河马，并且成为《河马历险记》的第一个读者。
“你写得真用心，故事非常有趣，而且真的太精彩了，
把稿子寄到大熊出版社去吧！”
没错，寄到大熊出版社试试看。不过，
现在先招待好朋友吃饭才是最重要的。
河马要亲自下厨做菜招待小老鼠。
他来到菜市场，买了烤肠、土豆、花椰菜
和蘑菇。
“回家喽！”河马拎着买好的菜乐呵呵地
往回走。

[P7] 前面有许多人围着，一片吵闹声。
发生了什么事情？
“小偷，站住，把公文包还给我。”
一只大熊一边追着三只大野狼，一边大叫道。大熊太胖了，跑得气喘吁吁。
三只大野狼扭着屁股嘲笑他说：“胖大熊，公文包在这儿，来追我们呀！”
太可恶了！
河马一甩手，把土豆扔在三只大野狼脚下。
“啊，啊，啊——”
三只大野狼摔了个四脚朝天。
“哈哈哈……”
河马捡起公文包，递给大熊。
三只大野狼？
哦，当然是警察把他们带走了！

[P8] “谢谢你！”大熊一定要请河马吃饭，
握着河马的手不肯放。
“算啦，我家还有客人等着我呢！”
最后河马干脆邀请大熊跟自己回家。河马
总觉得大熊有些眼熟，却怎么也想不起来
在哪里见过。

河马一回到家，就在厨房
忙了起来。
首先，他把菜洗干净。
然后，他把菜切好。
接着，他把菜倒入锅里炒。
河马的厨艺真不错，很快，
厨房里就飘出阵阵香味……

[P9] 吃完饭，河马请大熊坐在沙发上喝茶。大熊无意中看到了河马的书稿，就随手翻阅了起来，结果这一看就停不下来。
“我要出版这本书。”
啊？大熊要出版河马的书，难道他是——
没错，他就是大熊出版社的社长。

河马都做了什么菜？
酸辣土豆丝、香煎烤肠、清炒花椰菜、奶油蘑菇汤。
可以开吃啦。

[P10] 河马要亲自下厨做菜，他先做了什么？后做了什么？请观察下面的图片，给图片排序，把序号贴在图片的右下角。

河马写一本书，是怎么写出来的呢？按先后顺序请找到相应的贴纸，补充在后面。
full_text_en:
[P1] Math is here!
Understanding the sequence of events
Understanding the sequence of things
Hippo Wrote a Book
Text by Zhong Linjiao, Illustrations by Li Zhixing
Jin Dun Publishing House

[P2] The hippo was reading a storybook. It was so captivating that he finished it in one go. Now that he had no more books to read, he needed to buy some new ones.
But the weather was too hot, and the hippo didn't want to go to the bookstore. No problem—he could buy books without going to the store.

The hippo loved reading books published by Big Bear Publishing. A couple of days ago, he received an email from Big Bear Publishing. It contained information about new books and a letter from the publisher's director, which even included a photo of the director—of course, many fans received it.

[P3] The hippo turned on his computer, found the Big Bear Publishing House's online bookstore, selected some new books, 
filled in the delivery address and name, chose a payment method, and clicked to confirm the order. 
Next, he just had to sit at home and wait for the delivery person to bring the books.

The next day, right after finishing breakfast, the doorbell rang. 
Ding-dong, ding-dong— 
The delivery person brought the books! 
The hippo opened the box and checked whether all the books he ordered were there. 
Yes, these were the books. 
The hippo paid the money and immediately started flipping through the newly bought books.

[P4] A few days later, the newly bought books were finished. Looking at the bookshelf, he couldn't fit any more books on it.
What should he do? Without books to read, the hippo felt very uncomfortable. He couldn't even sleep!
The hippo was very troubled, so he called his good friend, the little mouse, to vent. The mouse said, "Why don't you write a book yourself?"
Write a book?
That's a great idea! Let's do it!
Actually, the hippo had thought about this before. He even dreamed of having his own book published by Big Bear Publishing House. But he had never put pen to paper.
"Hurry up and write! I'm waiting to read it!"

[P5] Encouraged by the little mouse, the hippo immediately took action. He decided to write an adventure book, titled 'The Hippo's Adventure'. First, he wrote a story outline, then began writing the story chapter by chapter.

The story went very smoothly. Every night before bed, the hippo would read through his own story again and again. In the story, the hippo was incredibly brave—he defeated the monster on Monster Mountain, helped the Elf King retrieve the Elf Key, and even chased the sun.

Writing a book was simply too much fun!

The book was finished. The hippo revised it over and over again, carefully and thoroughly, and now he was waiting to submit it.

[P6] The little mouse came to visit the hippo and became the first reader of 'Hippo's Adventure'.
"You wrote with such care, the story is very interesting, and it's truly wonderful!
Send the manuscript to Big Bear Publishing House!"
Right, let's try sending it to Big Bear Publishing House. But,
right now, it's most important to treat the good friend to a meal.
The hippo wanted to cook a meal himself to welcome the little mouse.
He went to the market and bought sausages, potatoes, cauliflower,
and mushrooms.
"Home we go!" The hippo happily carried the groceries back home.

[P7] There were many people gathered, making a lot of noise.
What was happening?
"Thief, stop! Give me back my briefcase!" 
A big bear chased after three big wolves, shouting. The bear was too fat and was out of breath.
The three big wolves twisted their bottoms and laughed, saying, "Fat bear, the briefcase is here, come catch us!"
How terrible!
Hippo threw a potato at the three big wolves with one flick of his hand.
"Ah, ah, ah——"
The three big wolves fell over, feet in the air.
"Hahaha..."
Hippo picked up the briefcase and handed it to the bear.
The three big wolves?
Oh, of course, the police took them away!

[P8] "Thank you!" The bear insisted on inviting the hippo to dinner, holding the hippo's hand tightly.
"No, no, I still have guests waiting for me at home!"
In the end, the hippo invited the bear to come home with him. The hippo always felt the bear looked familiar, but couldn't remember where he had seen him before.

As soon as the hippo got home, he started busy in the kitchen.
First, he washed the vegetables clean.
Then, he chopped them up.
Next, he poured the vegetables into the pan to stir-fry.
The hippo's cooking skills were excellent; soon, the kitchen filled with delicious aromas...

[P9] After dinner, the hippo invited the bear to sit on the sofa and have tea. The bear accidentally saw the hippo's manuscript and started flipping through it, and once he began, he couldn't stop.
"I want to publish this book."
Hmm? The bear wants to publish the hippo's book. Could it be that—
Yes, he is the publisher of Big Bear Publishing House.

What dishes did the hippo make?
Spicy potato shreds, pan-fried sausages, stir-fried cauliflower, and cream mushroom soup.
Let's eat!

[P10] The hippo is going to cook a meal himself. What did he do first? What did he do next? Please observe the pictures below, arrange them in order, and stick the numbers in the bottom right corner of each picture.

How does the hippo write a book? Please find the corresponding stickers in the correct order and complete the sequence below.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本的封面页，标题为《了解事物的展开顺序》，副标题《河马写了一本书》，作者为钟林姣，绘者为李志兴，出版社为金盾出版社。画面中一只老鼠坐在桌前阅读，桌上放有茶壶和茶杯。
[P2] 河马读完一本故事书后想买新书，但因天气太热不想去书店，于是选择通过大熊出版社的邮件获取新书信息和社长来信。
[P3] 河马通过网上书店订购书籍，第二天快递员送货上门，河马付款后立即翻阅新书。
[P4] 河马很快读完了新买的书，书架已满，他感到无聊和焦虑。于是他打电话给好朋友小老鼠倾诉，小老鼠建议他写一本书，河马深受启发，决定开始动笔写作。
[P5] 河马在小老鼠的鼓励下开始创作冒险书《河马历险记》，他先写大纲再按章节写作，故事内容充满冒险，完成后反复修改，准备投稿。
[P6] 小老鼠来访，成为《河马历险记》的第一个读者并鼓励河马投稿；河马决定先为朋友做饭，于是去菜市场买了食材后开心回家。
[P7] 河马在街上目睹一只大熊追赶三只大野狼，他见义勇为，用土豆击退野狼，随后将公文包归还给大熊，原来野狼已被警察带走。
[P8] 河马在街上帮助大熊赶走野狼后，大熊想请他吃饭，但河马婉拒并邀请大熊回家。河马回家后在厨房忙碌地洗菜、切菜、炒菜，厨房里飘出阵阵香味。
[P9] 河马为大熊准备了丰盛的晚餐，饭后大熊在沙发上阅读河马的书稿，被深深吸引并决定出版这本书，原来大熊正是大熊出版社的社长。
[P10] 本页为互动练习页，左侧要求按顺序排列河马做菜的四个步骤（买菜、洗菜、切菜、炒菜），右侧要求按顺序补充河马写书的四个步骤（写大纲、写作、修改、出版）。
